title: KHANARY XCFE Program Descriptor
description: Schema for individual XCFE program descriptor files (data/programs/<id>.json). ProgramLoader compiles these to KuhulVM bracket instructions. The descriptor is data — not semantic authority. The authority block enforces this: all three flags are invariantly false.

@no-eval.description: Prevents XCFE from treating the descriptor itself as an executable node.

id.description: Dot-namespaced program identifier. ProgramLoader resolves to data/programs/<id>.json.

phase.description: Canonical entry phase for this program.

executor.description: Hint only — XCFE remains route authority.

steps.description: Ordered bracket instructions. Forward-only C6 phase sequence enforced at runtime by the FoldGate.

ProgramClass.description: 10-value program-descriptor class. CONDITION/SELECTION/CAUSAL/TRANSFORM/VERIFICATION map to the 14-class node ISA. ITERATION/COMPOSITION/ROUTE/LEARNING/RETURN are program-descriptor level only — not in xcfe_node_class.h.

op.description: Documentation label only — not compiled into the Instruction. The gram key or operand goes in 'id'.

id.description: First operand: gram key for Pop/Xul, variable name, or other identifier. Maps to Instruction.id.

args.description: Additional string arguments. Maps to Instruction.args.

Authority.description: Invariant authority boundary. Policy != Control != Execution. A descriptor cannot be semantic or commit authority.

semantic_authority.description: A descriptor cannot grant semantic authority.

topology_mutation.description: delta_B != 0 commits only under Verified ∧ Authorized ∧ Fresh ∧ Xul.

commit_authorized.description: Commit authority belongs to Xul alone.
